name: Mercenary Divine Protection
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Divine Protection (players/priest/mercenary/divine_protection_merc.sval, 17 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 5 (in brackets): absorbs 30% (50%); 1 mana per point (0.5). Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: The shield absorbs 30% of incoming damage, at 1 mana per point absorbed.
